response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.observstation NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.observstation FROM telescopes t2 WHERE t2.equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: equipstatus value 'Maintenance' uses case-sensitive exact matching as specified in documentation (not 'maintenance' or 'MAINTENANCE')

alternatives.interpretation: Filter individual telescopes rather than entire stations: exclude only telescopes with equipstatus='Maintenance', and report stations that have at least one remaining telescope
